items.statement: A privately originated K_M can become a material unit of account if transaction demand, network liquidity and direct price/contract denomination become sufficiently deep.
Broad recurring K_C ownership plus a real consumption floor can reduce wealth concentration more reliably than currency revaluation alone.
Collective expertise-weighted governance can improve monetary credibility if scoring, conflicts, bounded influence, due process and auditability are robust.
Separating K_M from K_C reduces the conflict between transaction stability and speculative appreciation.
A transition from CAD-denominated activity toward K_M can reduce the real importance of legacy fixed nominal CAD debt, but cannot eliminate creditor-side losses or refinancing consequences.
Online-first QR settlement can materially reduce merchant onboarding cost if security and identity controls preserve payment authorization integrity.
